News refresh — 23 Nov 2026 (news-refresh mode)

No new ideas; no demotions. A quiet week (17–23 Nov) for the covered names: the Q2 FY27 season has wrapped, and no new bond or NCD prints, M&A or IPO milestones were found for any carded name in the window.

Rating actions (2): The Phoenix Mills — the grade steps up to AA+: India Ratings upgraded the bank facilities to IND AA+/Stable (1-Sep-26, previously missed by the card) and the ratings DB refreshed 22-Nov now records ICRA AA+ (Stable) as of 16-Nov-26 ⚑ rationale not sighted. Aditya Birla Renewables — ICRA's AA Rating Watch with Developing Implications stays live (recorded as of 17-Nov-26 in the ratings DB); resolution rests on the Rs 17,200 crore Solenergi/Sprng completion, due on or before 31-Dec-26. No other rating action on a carded or watchlist name appears in the 22-Nov ratings DB refresh.

Card updates (4): Biocon Biologics — USFDA approved Pebrilzo (pertuzumab biosimilar to Perjeta) on 16-Nov, the group's fifth US oncology biosimilar; US launch licensed from Q3 CY2028, Europe/UK slated Q1 CY2027. GMR Airports — AERA issued the Vizag International Airport tariff order (21-Nov); GVIAL levies the new charges from 1-Dec-26 ⚑. Plus the two rating-action updates above.

Watchlist: Bharat Forge approved a Rs 291 crore infusion into defence arm Kalyani Strategic Systems (19-Nov) ⚑ terms.
